Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

St. Nicholas Celebration 2025

December 20, 2025 · Bürgerkeller Ochsenfurt

The children and families of CMI gathered for a warm end-of-year celebration. Together they looked back on the many highlights of 2025 in a lovingly prepared photo presentation. The major benefit concerts, as well as shared excursions and experiences, stood out in particular and made the year so memorable. For the youngest guests, there were games and a creative craft corner where the children joyfully made and painted Christmas decorations. A range of festive treats and Christmas pastries invited everyone to enjoy the morning. The highlight was the visit from St. Nicholas, played by Ilhan Diler: each child received a personal message and a warm invitation to a shared cinema outing, including a movie voucher. After the celebration, the cheerful group headed to the cinema together and rounded off the day in a convivial atmosphere. Heartfelt thanks go to all the helpers, participants, and guests who made this morning so special!
